name: Kotoishi Iori
source:
A third-year student at Shisui-kan Academy.
She’s energetic, lively, and always optimistic.
She transfers to Shisui-kan Academy as a radiant girl whose very presence brightens the atmosphere around her.

Her motto is to always be true to herself, which sometimes leads to clashes with those around her.
In fact, she can be a bit stubborn and won’t back down once she’s made up her mind.

Her free-spirited demeanor has led others to describe her as “cat-like.”
She has a long list of “things she wants to do” and is trying to tackle them one by one.

Having been raised with great care by her parents, she’s a bit of a hopeless case when it comes to housework—she’s never really done any before and struggles with both cleaning and cooking.

“Love at first sight? Yeah, I’m the type to believe in it…
But do you even have a partner?
Wait, maybe you haven’t noticed? You’re so clueless!”
